description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of 'git status' in various scenarios, including different options, states, and submodule configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Configures global git settings for testing.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances internal clock or state as needed in testing.
